records.statement:
theorem angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, ψ s - θ s = ψ 0 - θ 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, HasDerivAt (fun t => ψ t - θ t) 0 s := by
    intro s hs
    have hk : deriv ψ s = deriv θ s := hκ s hs
    convert ((hψ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.sub
      (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt) using 1
    simp only [hk, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := isOpen_Ioo.exists_is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
    (convex_Ioo (0 : ℝ) ℓ).isPreconnected
    (fun s hs => (hd s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun s hs => (hd s hs).deriv)
  have hcc : EqOn (fun s => ψ s - θ s) (fun _ => c) (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    have heq : EqOn (fun s => ψ s - θ s) (fun _ => c) (Ioo 0 ℓ) := hc
    simpa only [closure_Ioo hℓ.ne] using
      heq.closure (hψ.continuous.sub hθ.continuous) continuous_const
  intro s hs
  exact (hcc hs).trans (hcc ⟨le_rfl, hℓ.le⟩).symm
records.comment:
Equal signed curvature on the interior fixes the difference of tangent angles
throughout the closed interval, including both endpoints.

records.statement:
theorem angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (h₀ : ψ 0 = θ 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, ψ s = θ s
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  have h := angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq hℓ hθ hψ hκ s hs
  rw [h₀, sub_self] at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
records.comment: Initial real angle plus the curvature function determines the angle lift.

records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord
  refine congrArg (fun z : ℝ => x₀ + z) (intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_)
  intro t ht
  rw [uIcc_of_le hs.1] at ht
  change cos (ψ t) = cos (θ t)
  rw [h ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hs.2⟩]
records.comment: The coordinate reconstruction only reads the angle on its integration interval.

records.proof:
by
  unfold yCoord
  refine congrArg (fun z : ℝ => y₀ + z) (intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_)
  intro t ht
  rw [uIcc_of_le hs.1] at ht
  change sin (ψ t) = sin (θ t)
  rw [h ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hs.2⟩]

records.statement:
theorem reconstruction_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (h₀ : ψ 0 = θ 0) (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      xCoord ψ x₀ s = xCoord θ x₀ s ∧ yCoord ψ y₀ s = yCoord θ y₀ s
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  have ha := angle_eq_of_curvature_eq_initial hℓ hθ hψ hκ h₀
  exact ⟨xCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs x₀, yCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs y₀⟩
records.comment: Fixed initial point and initial real angle remove the remaining freedom.

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_add_angle {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (α x₀ y₀ x₁ s : ℝ) :
    xCoord (fun u => θ u + α) x₁ s - x₁ =
      cos α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) - sin α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀)
records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord yCoord
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, cos_add]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    (f := fun u => cos (θ u) * cos α) (g := fun u => sin (θ u) * sin α)
    (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := s)
    (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
    (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s),
    intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  ring
records.comment: Adding a constant angle rotates the displacement through that angle.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_add_angle {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    (α x₀ y₀ y₁ s : ℝ) :
    yCoord (fun u => θ u + α) y₁ s - y₁ =
      sin α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) + cos α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀)
records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord yCoord
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, sin_add]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add
    (f := fun u => sin (θ u) * cos α) (g := fun u => cos (θ u) * sin α)
    (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := s)
    (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
    (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 s),
    intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  ring

records.statement:
theorem reconstruction_rotation_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ α : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s)
    (hα : α = ψ 0 - θ 0) (x₀ y₀ x₁ y₁ : ℝ) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      xCoord ψ x₁ s - x₁ =
        cos α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) - sin α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀) ∧
      yCoord ψ y₁ s - y₁ =
        sin α * (xCoord θ x₀ s - x₀) + cos α * (yCoord θ y₀ s - y₀)
records.proof:
by
  have ha : EqOn ψ (fun s => θ s + α) (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    intro s hs
    have h := angle_sub_eq_initial_of_curvature_eq hℓ hθ hψ hκ s hs
    rw [← hα] at h
    linarith
  intro s hs
  rw [xCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs x₁, yCoord_eq_of_angle_eq ha hs y₁]
  exact ⟨xCoord_add_angle hθ.continuous α x₀ y₀ x₁ s,
    yCoord_add_angle hθ.continuous α x₀ y₀ y₁ s⟩
records.comment:
Equal signed curvature gives an explicit orientation-preserving rigid motion.
Here α is exactly the difference of the two chosen initial angle lifts.

records.statement:
theorem energy_eq_of_curvature_eq {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (hκ : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, curvature ψ s = curvature θ s) (ε : ℝ → ℝ) :
    energy ε ψ ℓ = energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have hcc : EqOn (deriv ψ) (deriv θ) (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    have heq : EqOn (deriv ψ) (deriv θ) (Ioo 0 ℓ) := hκ
    simpa only [closure_Ioo hℓ.ne] using
      heq.closure hψ.continuous_deriv_one hθ.continuous_deriv_one
  unfold energy
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s hs
  rw [uIcc_of_le hℓ.le] at hs
  change ε (deriv ψ s) = ε (deriv θ s)
  rw [hcc hs]
records.comment:
Since the density reads only signed curvature, equal curvature gives equal energy.
No evenness, convexity, or regularity assumption on the density is needed here.

records.statement:
theorem middle_replacement_boundary_and_weight_ratio
    {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ))
    (hx : (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s))
    (hy : (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = ∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s))
    (β x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    (θ 0 = φ 0 ∧ θ ℓ = φ ℓ ∧
      xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = xCoord φ x₀ ℓ ∧ yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = yCoord φ y₀ ℓ) ∧
    exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ / exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ =
      exp (-β * ((∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) -
        (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))))
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨boundary_eq_of_middle_integrals hθ.continuous hφ.continuous
    ha hab hb hleft hright hx hy x₀ y₀, ?_⟩
  have henergy := energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq
    hε hθ hφ ha hab hb hleft hright
  rw [exponentialWeight, exponentialWeight, ← exp_sub, ← mul_sub, henergy]
records.comment:
The original boundary data are preserved, and the ratio of whole-curve
weights depends only on the middle energy difference. No sign on `β` or on the
energy is needed for this identity.

records.statement:
theorem middle_energy_lt_iff_exponentialWeight_lt
    {ε θ φ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hleft : EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a)) (hright : EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ)) :
    (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) < (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)) ↔
      exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ < exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have henergy := energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq
    hε hθ hφ ha hab hb hleft hright
  rw [← energy_lt_iff_exponentialWeight_lt hβ]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
records.comment:
With the exterior fixed, strict improvement of the middle energy is
equivalent to strict increase of the whole-curve weight. Feasibility follows
from the preceding theorem when the two middle displacements also match.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_middle_replacement_comparison
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ →
      EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a) → EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ) →
      (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s)) →
      (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s)) →
      (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, |φ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv φ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s)) ≤ (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) ∧
        exponentialWeight β ε φ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hminimal⟩ := hmin
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ hleft hright hx hy hclose
  obtain ⟨hzero, hend, hxglobal, hyglobal⟩ := boundary_eq_of_middle_integrals
    hθ.continuous hφ.continuous ha hab hb hleft hright hx hy 0 0
  have hcos : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (φ s)) = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) := by
    simpa only [xCoord, zero_add] using hxglobal.symm
  have hsin : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (φ s)) = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s) := by
    simpa only [yCoord, zero_add] using hyglobal.symm
  have he := hminimal φ hφ hzero.symm hend.symm hcos hsin
    (C1_close_of_middle_close hθ hφ hr hleft hright hclose)
  have henergy := energy_sub_eq_middle_of_outer_angle_eq
    hε hθ hφ ha hab hb hleft hright
  exact ⟨by linarith, (energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le hβ ε θ φ ℓ).mp he⟩
records.comment:
A whole-curve C¹ local minimum cannot be improved by sufficiently small
smooth middle replacements preserving middle displacement. Only middle C¹
closeness is required: exterior derivative agreement and all global endpoint
conditions are derived. The same replacement cannot increase the whole weight.

records.statement:
theorem not_locallyMinimizing_of_arbitrarily_close_middle_improvements
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b ℓ : ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ ℓ)
    (himprove : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ EqOn θ φ (Icc 0 a) ∧ EqOn θ φ (Icc b ℓ) ∧
      (∫ s in a..b, cos (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, cos (φ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in a..b, sin (θ s)) = (∫ s in a..b, sin (φ s)) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Icc a b, |φ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv φ s - deriv θ s| < r) ∧
      (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv φ s)) < (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))) :
    ¬ LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  intro hmin
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcompare⟩ := locallyMinimizing_middle_replacement_comparison
    (β := 1) zero_lt_one hε hθ ha hab hb hmin
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hleft, hright, hx, hy, hclose, himproved⟩ := himprove r hr
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hcompare φ hφ hleft hright hx hy hclose).1) himproved
records.comment:
Arbitrarily small C¹ middle improvements exclude a constrained local
minimum of the whole curve. The hypothesis supplies actual globally smooth
replacements and their exact displacement matching, not just formal directions.

records.proof:
by
  by_contra h
  have hq : q < 0 := lt_of_not_ge h
  have hmax : IsLocalMax f x := isLocalMax_of_deriv_deriv_neg
    (by rw [hsecond.deriv]; exact hq) hmin.deriv_eq_zero hc
  have heq : f =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => f x := by
    filter_upwards [hmin, hmax] with y hy hy'
    exact le_antisymm hy' hy
  have hz : deriv (deriv f) x = 0 := by
    simpa using heq.deriv.deriv_eq
  rw [hsecond.deriv] at hz
  linarith
records.comment:
The second derivative of a continuous scalar function at a local minimum
is nonnegative, whenever that derivative exists.

records.proof: hθ.comp (contDiff_id.div_const a)
records.comment: Reparametrization by a constant scale preserves the stated smoothness.

records.proof:
by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] using
    hθ.comp s ((hasDerivAt_id s).div_const a)
records.comment: Chain rule for the angle at the rescaled arc-length parameter.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_angle_scaling {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (a s : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => θ (t / a)) s = deriv θ (s / a) / a
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_angle_scaling (hθ (s / a)).hasDerivAt).deriv

records.statement:
theorem curvature_angle_scaling {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (a s : ℝ) :
    curvature (fun t => θ (t / a)) s = curvature θ (s / a) / a
records.proof: deriv_angle_scaling hθ a s
records.comment: Signed curvature scales by the reciprocal of a positive similarity.

records.statement:
theorem angle_scaling_endpoints (θ : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    (fun s => θ (s / a)) 0 = θ 0 ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  simp [ha.ne']
records.comment: The lifted initial and terminal tangent angles are unchanged.

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_scaling (θ : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (x₀ s : ℝ) :
    xCoord (fun t => θ (t / a)) (a * x₀) (a * s) = a * xCoord θ x₀ s
records.proof:
by
  unfold xCoord
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_div (fun t => Real.cos (θ t)) ha.ne']
  simp [ha.ne', smul_eq_mul, mul_add]
records.comment: The actual horizontal reconstruction is multiplied by the scale.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_scaling (θ : ℝ → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (y₀ s : ℝ) :
    yCoord (fun t => θ (t / a)) (a * y₀) (a * s) = a * yCoord θ y₀ s
records.proof:
by
  unfold yCoord
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_div (fun t => Real.sin (θ t)) ha.ne']
  simp [ha.ne', smul_eq_mul, mul_add]
records.comment: The actual vertical reconstruction is multiplied by the scale.

records.statement:
theorem scaled_boundary_data {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {a ℓ x₀ y₀ x₁ y₁ α β : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hx : xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₁) (hy : yCoord θ y₀ ℓ = y₁)
    (hα : θ 0 = α) (hβ : θ ℓ = β) :
    0 < a * ℓ ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun s => θ (s / a)) ∧
      xCoord (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * x₀) (a * ℓ) = a * x₁ ∧
      yCoord (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * y₀) (a * ℓ) = a * y₁ ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) 0 = α ∧
      (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = β
records.proof:
by
  refine ⟨mul_pos ha hℓ, contDiff_angle_scaling hθ a, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [xCoord_scaling θ ha, hx]
  · rw [yCoord_scaling θ ha, hy]
  · simpa only [zero_div] using hα
  · simpa [ha.ne'] using hβ
records.comment:
A C¹ curve with prescribed boundary data yields a C¹ curve for the scaled
length and positions, with exactly the same real endpoint-angle lifts.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      a * ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s / a)
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  simp_rw [deriv_angle_scaling hθ]
  simpa [ha.ne', smul_eq_mul] using
    (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_div (fun s => ε (deriv θ s / a))
      (a := 0) (b := a * ℓ) ha.ne')
records.comment:
General density transformation, obtained from the chain rule and change of
variables in the actual interval integral.  No homogeneity is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = (a * c) * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_scaling hθ ha]
  simp_rw [hε]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  simp only [energy, mul_assoc]
records.comment:
A density multiplier at the chosen scale induces the energy multiplier
`a * c`.  The density hypothesis is separate from the general scaling identity.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling_of_homogeneous {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hε : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ q : ℝ, ε (t * q) = t ^ m * ε q) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) = a ^ (1 - m) * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have hf : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = (a⁻¹) ^ m * ε q := by
    intro q
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm q] using hε a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) q
  rw [energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hf ℓ]
  rw [Real.inv_rpow ha.le m, Real.rpow_sub ha 1 m, Real.rpow_one]
  rfl
records.comment:
A density homogeneous of real degree `m` under positive scaling gives the
energy law `a^(1-m)`.  Homogeneity is an additional hypothesis, not a consequence
of the general smooth-density definition.

records.statement:
theorem energy_scaling_quadratic {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (k ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      energy (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ / a
records.proof:
by
  have hf : ∀ q : ℝ, k * (q / a) ^ 2 / 2 = (a⁻¹) ^ 2 * (k * q ^ 2 / 2) := by
    intro q
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]
    ring
  rw [energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hf ℓ]
  field_simp
records.comment:
The classical quadratic curvature density has reciprocal energy scaling.
The identity holds for every coefficient `k`; positivity is not needed here.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a c ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmin⟩ := hmin
  let δ := r / (a + 1)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := div_pos hr (by linarith)
  have hδr : δ < r := (div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < a + 1)).mpr (by nlinarith)
  have haδr : a * δ < r := by
    have he : δ * (a + 1) = r := div_mul_cancel₀ r (by linarith : a + 1 ≠ 0)
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro ψ hψ hψ0 hψℓ hx hy hclose
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ψ (s / a⁻¹)
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ := contDiff_angle_scaling hψ a⁻¹
  have hround : (fun s => φ (s / a)) = ψ := by
    funext s
    simp [φ, ha.ne']
  have hθdiff := hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hφdiff := hφ.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hφ0 : φ 0 = θ 0 := by simpa [φ] using hψ0
  have hφℓ : φ ℓ = θ ℓ := by
    have hal : a * ℓ / a = ℓ := by field_simp
    simp only [hal] at hψℓ
    simpa [φ, div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hψℓ
  have hφx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (φ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) := by
    have heφ := xCoord_scaling φ ha 0 ℓ
    have heθ := xCoord_scaling θ ha 0 ℓ
    simp only [xCoord, mul_zero, zero_add] at heφ heθ
    simp_rw [show ∀ s, φ (s / a) = ψ s from congrFun hround] at heφ
    rw [heφ, heθ] at hx
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ ha.ne') hx
  have hφy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (φ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) := by
    have heφ := yCoord_scaling φ ha 0 ℓ
    have heθ := yCoord_scaling θ ha 0 ℓ
    simp only [yCoord, mul_zero, zero_add] at heφ heθ
    simp_rw [show ∀ s, φ (s / a) = ψ s from congrFun hround] at heφ
    rw [heφ, heθ] at hy
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ ha.ne') hy
  have hφclose : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      |φ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv φ s - deriv θ s| < r := by
    intro s hs
    have has : a * s ∈ Icc 0 (a * ℓ) :=
      ⟨mul_nonneg ha.le hs.1, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 ha.le⟩
    obtain ⟨hval, hder⟩ := hclose (a * s) has
    have hsa : a * s / a = s := by field_simp
    simp only [hsa] at hval
    constructor
    · have hv : |φ s - θ s| < δ := by
        simpa [φ, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hval
      exact hv.trans hδr
    · rw [deriv_angle_scaling hθdiff, hsa] at hder
      have hdφ : deriv φ s = a * deriv ψ (a * s) := by
        rw [show φ = (fun s => ψ (s / a⁻¹)) from rfl,
          deriv_angle_scaling (hψ.differentiable one_ne_zero)]
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
      have hd : deriv φ s - deriv θ s =
          a * (deriv ψ (a * s) - deriv θ s / a) := by
        rw [hdφ]
        field_simp
      rw [hd, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ha]
      exact (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hder ha).trans haδr
  have he := hmin φ hφ hφ0 hφℓ hφx hφy hφclose
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (mul_pos ha hc).le
  rw [← energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθdiff ha hε ℓ,
    ← energy_scaling_of_density_factor hφdiff ha hε ℓ, hround] at hscaled
  exact hscaled
records.comment:
A positive density multiplier transports a C¹ constrained local minimum.
The proof pulls every nearby scaled competitor back to the original interval.
If the original radius is `r`, the scaled radius `r / (a + 1)` suffices.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a c ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) ↔
      LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    have hi : ∀ q, ε (q / a⁻¹) = c⁻¹ * ε q := by
      intro q
      have he : ε q = c * ε (q / a⁻¹) := by
        simpa [div_div, ha.ne'] using hε (q / a⁻¹)
      calc
        ε (q / a⁻¹) = c⁻¹ * (c * ε (q / a⁻¹)) := by simp [hc.ne']
        _ = c⁻¹ * ε q := by rw [← he]
    have hm := locallyMinimizing_scaling_of_density_factor
      (inv_pos.mpr ha) (inv_pos.mpr hc) (contDiff_angle_scaling hθ a) hi hmin
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, ha.ne', mul_assoc] using hm
  · exact locallyMinimizing_scaling_of_density_factor ha hc hθ hε
records.comment:
Positive similarity is reversible on the actual constrained C¹ local-minimum
property, including its neighborhood and all endpoint constraints.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_homogeneous {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a m ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hε : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ q : ℝ, ε (t * q) = t ^ m * ε q) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) ↔
      LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  apply locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_density_factor ha
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha) m) hθ
  intro q
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm q] using hε a⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr ha) q
records.comment:
Real-degree homogeneous densities transport local minima under every
positive similarity. The degree may be arbitrary: the energy multiplier is
positive even when the energy itself is not.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_quadratic {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    {a ℓ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (k : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) ↔
      LocallyMinimizing (fun q => k * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  apply locallyMinimizing_scaling_iff_of_density_factor ha
    (sq_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ha)) hθ
  intro q
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]
  ring
records.comment:
In particular the classical quadratic density has equivalent constrained
local-minimum problems at positively scaled boundary data.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_scaling_of_density_factor {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) (β ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight β ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      exponentialWeight (β * (a * c)) ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  unfold exponentialWeight
  rw [energy_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hε ℓ]
  congr 1
  ring
records.comment:
The scale factor in energy can be absorbed into the weight parameter.
No probabilistic interpretation of the exponential weight is required.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_scaling_rescaled_parameter {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ) {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hε : ∀ q, ε (q / a) = c * ε q) (β ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight (β / (a * c)) ε (fun s => θ (s / a)) (a * ℓ) =
      exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [exponentialWeight_scaling_of_density_factor hθ ha hε]
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (mul_ne_zero ha.ne' hc)]
records.comment:
Changing the weight parameter by the reciprocal of the positive energy
scale preserves the numerical weight of each curve.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation {ε κ v w : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε) (hκ : Continuous κ)
    (hv : Continuous v) (hw : Continuous w) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ε (κ s + t * v s) * w s)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (κ s + t₀ * v s) * v s * w s) t₀
records.proof:
by
  have hεd : Differentiable ℝ ε := hε.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hε' : Continuous (deriv ε) := hε.continuous_deriv_one
  have hc : Continuous
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deriv ε (κ p.2 + p.1 * v p.2) * v p.2 * w p.2) :=
    ((hε'.comp ((hκ.comp continuous_snd).add
      (continuous_fst.mul (hv.comp continuous_snd)))).mul
      (hv.comp continuous_snd)).mul (hw.comp continuous_snd)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1))).prod
      (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
  have hmeas (t : ℝ) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => ε (κ s + t * v s) * w s) (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    ((hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hw).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hint : Integrable (fun s => ε (κ s + t₀ * v s) * w s)
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    (((hε.continuous.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hw).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ).1
  have hmeas' : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun s => deriv ε (κ s + t₀ * v s) * v s * w s)
      (volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ)) :=
    (((hε'.comp (hκ.add (continuous_const.mul hv))).mul hv).mul hw).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ),
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1), ‖deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s * w s‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with s hs
    intro t ht
    exact hC (t, s) ⟨⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩, ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioc 0 ℓ), ∀ t ∈ Ioo (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1),
      HasDerivAt (fun t => ε (κ s + t * v s) * w s)
        (deriv ε (κ s + t * v s) * v s * w s) t := by
    filter_upwards [] with s
    intro t _
    convert ((hεd (κ s + t * v s)).hasDerivAt.comp t
      (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const (v s)).const_add (κ s))).mul_const (w s) using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | ring
  have h := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith : t₀ - 1 < t₀) (by linarith : t₀ < t₀ + 1))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hmeas) hint hmeas' hbound
    (integrable_const C) hdiff
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ] using h.2
records.comment:
A weighted form of differentiation under the curvature integral, valid at
every real parameter value. The weight does not depend on that parameter.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_variation_at {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation θ η u) ℓ)
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s + t * deriv η s) * deriv η s) t
records.proof:
by
  have h := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (w := fun _ => 1) hℓ hε
    hθ.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one continuous_const t
  simpa only [mul_one, energy,
    deriv_angleVariation (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero) (hη.differentiable one_ne_zero)] using h
records.comment: The first derivative of the actual energy at every variation parameter.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_energy_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s) ^ 2) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd : deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) =
      fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s + t * deriv η s) * deriv η s := by
    funext t
    exact (hasDerivAt_energy_variation_at hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ hη t).deriv
  rw [hd]
  have h := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (ε := deriv ε)
    (κ := deriv θ) (v := deriv η) (w := deriv η) hℓ hε.deriv'
    hθ.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one 0
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero, mul_assoc, ← pow_two] using h
records.comment:
Differentiate the already identified first derivative of the actual energy.
Its second variation is the curvature-density second derivative times `(η')²`.

records.statement:
theorem secondVariation_energy {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    deriv (deriv (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)) 0 =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s) ^ 2
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_deriv_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη).deriv
records.comment: The actual second derivative, rather than a separately defined quadratic form.

records.statement:
theorem mixedVariation_energy {ε θ η ξ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (hξ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ξ) :
    deriv (fun t => deriv
      (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ η t) ξ u) ℓ) 0) 0 =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * deriv η s * deriv ξ s
records.proof:
by
  have hd (t : ℝ) :
      deriv (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ η t) ξ u) ℓ) 0 =
        ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s + t * deriv η s) * deriv ξ s := by
    have ht : ContDiff ℝ 1 (angleVariation θ η t) :=
      hθ.add (contDiff_const.mul hη)
    simpa only [deriv_angleVariation (hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero)
      (hη.differentiable one_ne_zero)] using
      (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) ht hξ).deriv
  simp_rw [hd]
  have h := hasDerivAt_weighted_integral_variation (ε := deriv ε)
    (κ := deriv θ) (v := deriv η) (w := deriv ξ) hℓ hε.deriv'
    hθ.continuous_deriv_one hη.continuous_deriv_one hξ.continuous_deriv_one 0
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_zero] using h.deriv
records.comment: The actual mixed derivative for the two angle directions `η` and `ξ`.

records.statement:
theorem mixedVariation_energy_symmetric {ε θ η ξ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (hξ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ξ) :
    deriv (fun t => deriv
      (fun u => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ η t) ξ u) ℓ) 0) 0 =
    deriv (fun u => deriv
      (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation (angleVariation θ ξ u) η t) ℓ) 0) 0
records.proof:
by
  rw [mixedVariation_energy hℓ hε hθ hη hξ, mixedVariation_energy hℓ hε hθ hξ hη]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s _
  dsimp
  ring
records.comment: Interchanging the two angle-variation directions preserves the mixed derivative.

records.statement:
theorem exists_multipliers_of_kernel
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (f c₁ c₂ : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (h : ∀ v, c₁ v = 0 → c₂ v = 0 → f v = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ v, f v + lam * c₁ v + μ * c₂ v = 0
records.proof:
by
  let c : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := c₁.prod c₂
  have hf : f ∈ (LinearMap.ker c).dualAnnihilator := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
    intro v hv
    have hv' : c v = 0 := hv
    exact h v (congrArg Prod.fst hv') (congrArg Prod.snd hv')
  rw [← LinearMap.range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker] at hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨-g (1, 0), -g (0, 1), ?_⟩
  intro v
  have hgv : g (c v) = f v := DFunLike.congr_fun hg v
  have hc : c v = (c₁ v) • (1, 0) + (c₂ v) • (0, 1) := by
    ext <;> simp [c]
  rw [hc, map_add, map_smul, map_smul] at hgv
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hgv
  nlinarith
records.comment:
Vanishing on the kernel of two linear constraints gives two multipliers.
No rank or independence assumption is needed for this implication.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_multipliers {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (hM : Continuous M)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) +
      lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  exact exists_multipliers_of_kernel (firstVariationLinear ℓ M hM)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => -sin (θ s)) (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg)
    (constraintLinear ℓ (fun s => cos (θ s)) (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ)) hstat
records.comment: The multiplier theorem for the actual elastica integral functionals.

records.statement:
theorem residual_zero_of_weighted_square_integral {ℓ : ℝ} {r : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hr : Continuous r)
    (hint : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, s * (ℓ - s) * (r s) ^ 2) = 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, r s = 0
records.proof:
by
  intro s hs
  by_contra hne
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => t * (ℓ - t) * (r t) ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ t in 0..ℓ, t * (ℓ - t) * (r t) ^ 2 := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_lt_integral_of_continuousOn_of_le_of_exists_lt
      hℓ continuousOn_const hcont.continuousOn
      (fun t ht => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht.1.le (sub_nonneg.mpr ht.2)) (sq_nonneg _))
      ⟨s, ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩, mul_pos (mul_pos hs.1 (sub_pos.mpr hs.2)) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hne)⟩
    simpa using h
  linarith
records.comment: Weighted square form of the fundamental lemma, with explicit positivity.

records.statement:
theorem firstVariation_by_parts {ℓ : ℝ} {M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) =
      -(∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv M s * η.val s)
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
    (fun s _ => (hM.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt)
    (fun s _ => (η.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt)
    (hM.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
    (η.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
  simpa [η.property.2.1, η.property.2.2] using h
records.comment: Integration by parts with the two fixed-end boundary terms removed.

records.statement:
theorem augmented_integral_eq_residual {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (hq : Continuous q) (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) =
      ∫ s in 0..ℓ, (-deriv M s + q s) * η.val s
records.proof:
by
  rw [firstVariation_by_parts hM η]
  simp_rw [add_mul, neg_mul]
  have he := intervalIntegral.integral_add
    (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := ℓ)
    (f := fun s => -(deriv M s * η.val s)) (g := fun s => q s * η.val s)
    ((hM.continuous_deriv_one.mul η.property.1.continuous).neg.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    ((hq.mul η.property.1.continuous).intervalIntegrable _ _)
  simpa only [intervalIntegral.integral_neg] using he.symm
records.comment: Combining the two terms of a first variation into its Euler residual.

records.statement:
theorem residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s
records.proof:
by
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => -deriv M s + q s
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ 1 r := (hM.deriv').neg.add hq
  let η : variationSpace ℓ :=
    ⟨fun s => s * (ℓ - s) * r s,
      ⟨(contDiff_id.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)).mul hr, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  have hint := hstat η
  rw [augmented_integral_eq_residual (hM.of_le (by norm_num)) hq.continuous η] at hint
  have hint' : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, s * (ℓ - s) * (r s) ^ 2) = 0 := by
    convert hint using 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s _
    change s * (ℓ - s) * (r s) ^ 2 = r s * (s * (ℓ - s) * r s)
    ring
  have hz := residual_zero_of_weighted_square_integral hℓ hr.continuous hint'
  intro s hs
  have := hz s hs
  dsimp [r] at this
  linarith
records.comment:
The residual-derived test function is C¹ and has zero endpoint values.
This is the step that keeps the fundamental lemma within the stated variation family.

records.statement:
theorem augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M) (hq : Continuous q)
    (hEL : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s) :
    ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hcc : EqOn (deriv M) q (Icc 0 ℓ) := by
    have hh : EqOn (deriv M) q (Ioo 0 ℓ) := hEL
    have hc := hh.closure hM.continuous_deriv_one hq
    simpa only [closure_Ioo hℓ.ne] using hc
  intro η
  rw [augmented_integral_eq_residual hM hq η]
  calc
    _ = ∫ s in 0..ℓ, (0 : ℝ) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [uIcc_of_le hℓ.le] at hs
      change (-deriv M s + q s) * η.val s = 0
      rw [hcc hs]
      ring
    _ = 0 := by simp
records.comment:
The converse integration-by-parts implication needs only C¹ for M.
Equality on the interior extends to the endpoints by continuity.

records.statement:
theorem augmented_stationary_iff_residual_zero {ℓ : ℝ} {M q : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M) (hq : ContDiff ℝ 1 q) :
    (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) + (∫ s in 0..ℓ, q s * η.val s) = 0) ↔
      ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = q s
records.proof:
⟨residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary hℓ hM hq,
    augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero hℓ (hM.of_le (by norm_num)) hq.continuous⟩
records.comment: For this smoothness class the integral condition and angle residual are equivalent.

records.statement:
theorem force_integral {ℓ lam μ : ℝ} {θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : Continuous θ) (η : variationSpace ℓ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, (-lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) * η.val s) =
      lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) +
      μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s)
records.proof:
by
  have hi₁ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => lam * (-sin (θ s) * η.val s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg.mul η.property.1.continuous)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have hi₂ : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => μ * (cos (θ s) * η.val s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).mul η.property.1.continuous)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  calc
    _ = ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
        lam * (-sin (θ s) * η.val s) + μ * (cos (θ s) * η.val s) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hi₁ hi₂,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
records.comment: The integrated force term is the linear combination of endpoint constraints.

records.statement:
theorem angleEquation_of_stationary {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M)
    (hstat : ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv M s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hm⟩ := stationary_multipliers hθ.continuous hM.continuous hstat
  refine ⟨lam, μ, residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary hℓ hM
    ((contDiff_const.mul hθ.sin).add (contDiff_const.mul hθ.cos)) ?_⟩
  intro η
  rw [force_integral hθ.continuous η]
  linarith [hm η]
records.comment: Concrete constrained stationarity implies the classical angle equation.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_of_angleEquation {ℓ lam μ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 1 M)
    (hEL : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv M s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) :
    ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0
records.proof:
by
  have hq : Continuous (fun s => -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) :=
    (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ)).add
      (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ))
  intro η hx hy
  have h := augmented_stationary_of_residual_zero hℓ hM hq hEL η
  rw [force_integral hθ η, hx, hy] at h
  simpa using h
records.comment: A solution of the angle equation is stationary under the linearized constraints.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff_exists_angleEquation {ℓ : ℝ} {θ M : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 M) :
    (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, M s * deriv η.val s) = 0) ↔
    (∃ lam μ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv M s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s))
records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact angleEquation_of_stationary hℓ hθ hM
  · rintro ⟨lam, μ, hEL⟩
    exact stationary_of_angleEquation hℓ hθ.continuous (hM.of_le (by norm_num)) hEL
records.comment:
Full equivalence with the linearized fixed-position constraints.
It says neither that a stationary curve minimizes energy nor that admissible
curves exist for arbitrary boundary data.
